steps: Scope and audit: address MC08, MC13, MC25, MC34 and MC35 with G4/G18 interactions. Use the accepted typing repair and rejection exchanges as the preservation baseline. The question is whether each integration-added field has an explicit validation rule and specified observable outcome. Reject test counts, journal balance and prototype behavior as acceptance substitutes. Stop before source research, lifecycle expansion or runtime implementation.

Begin with a focused comparison of accounting-integration-contract-v1.md, accounting-integration-typing-contract-v1.md, accounting-integration-fixtures-v2.json and accounting-integration-rejections-contract-v1.md with its fixtures. Enumerate the added fields and dependent references in a saved validation matrix. For each, identify its governing type, required/null behavior, binding or version constraint, validation stage, failure outcome, existing example and remaining gap. Classify intentional unknowns separately from malformed values.

Save a versioned accounting-integration-field-validation-v1.md supplement and companion JSON matrix under docs/design/proposal/architecture/. Specify only missing rules needed to make this field inventory coherent. Preserve existing accepted semantics; disclose any discovered contradiction as a targeted repair rather than silently changing a predecessor. Explain why explicit validation is preferred to downstream rejection or permissive coercion on the same input.

Add companion design fixtures only for uncovered predicates. Pair each defect with a valid control differing in the relevant condition, retaining exact request/dependency identities. Specify stage, diagnostic, receipt visibility, null outputs and unchanged committed domains where applicable. Preserve validation-before-lookup and exact-replay behavior. Reuse existing cases by exact reference when they already cover a predicate; do not duplicate them merely to increase counts.

Verify the saved matrix and fixtures with a bounded standard-library document diagnostic, without adding product modules or a test suite. Check complete field inventory, explicit dispositions for uncovered cases, reference resolution, declared types, version distinctions, source hashes, expected failure ordering and preservation of accepted controls. Treat uncovered predicates or contradictory outcomes as repair triggers. Store fresh verification and integrity records; never overwrite historical reports.

Reconcile architecture.json, result.md and progress.md with the terminal rejection acceptance and this slice's actual status. Pin new substantive files and retain all wider residuals. Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py --phase P16 --check into fresh task-local output, validate nonempty JSON and record the exit status and actual failures. The known whole-architecture failure remains compatible with completion of this bounded slice, but any new failure requires investigation.

Stop condition: the inventory covers every integration-added field, each row has a precise validation disposition and located evidence, missing cases have specified outcomes, predecessor integrity holds, and fresh bounded checks are recorded. Return PARTIAL, explicitly withholding integration and P16 acceptance. If time expires earlier, save the completed subsection and identify the exact remaining rows rather than restarting the broad integration plan.
summary: Plan the next bounded P16 task: complete the integration added-field validation specification while preserving the independently accepted rejection exchanges. Keep source/method-context assessment and lifecycle work separate.
